primary_title: Detrimental and protective action of microglial extracellular vesicles on myelin lesions: astrocyte involvement in remyelination failure
decision_basis: The review-cited primary reports that inflammatory microglia-derived EVs directly enhance OPC differentiation into MBP-expressing cells when OPCs are studied without astrocytes; the same EVs inhibit maturation in astrocyte coculture, establishing a context-dependent split.
limitations_preserved: Keep the direct OPC-monoculture result separate from the astrocyte-dependent inhibition row; do not infer a receptor, cargo, transcription factor or traumatic-SCI effect.

primary_title: Microglial vesicles improve post-stroke recovery by preventing immune cell senescence and favoring oligodendrogenesis
decision_basis: The review-cited primary reports that intracerebral infusion of regenerative microglia-derived EVs increases maturation of GPR17-expressing OPCs at lesion borders after permanent middle cerebral artery occlusion.
